name: Raklet API
description:
Raklet is an all-in-one membership management and community platform for associations, nonprofits, clubs, chambers and alumni organizations. This API lets you manage an organization's contacts and members, membership plans and payments, events, tags, donations and settings programmatically.

## Authentication

Every endpoint except `POST /token` requires a bearer token. Obtain one with the OAuth 2.0 password grant, using the email and password of a Raklet admin user:

```
curl -X POST https://api.raklet.com/token \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "grant_type=password&username=admin@example.org&password=..."
```

Then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on every request. Tokens expire after about one hour; request a new one the same way. The token carries the admin user's own permissions: it can do exactly what that user can do in the Raklet admin panel for the organizations they administer, and nothing more. There are no narrower OAuth scopes today.

## Finding your organisation id

Most paths take `{organisationId}`. Find it in the Raklet admin panel under Settings, or call `GET /public/account/me` with your token.

## Plans and access

API access is included in the Premium plan (see https://www.raklet.com/pricing/). A free organization (up to 100 contacts) is the recommended sandbox for development.

## Conventions

- Base URL: `https://api.raklet.com`
- Request and response bodies are JSON unless an operation says otherwise.
- List endpoints accept `pageSize` and `offset`; filtered lists accept `q`, a base64-encoded JSON query (see https://help.raklet.com/en/articles/5998452-how-to-search-organisation-contacts).
- Most responses wrap their payload in `{ "data": ..., "isValid": true, "errors": [] }`.

## More

- Developer portal: https://www.raklet.com/developers/
- Interactive reference (Swagger UI): https://api.raklet.com/swagger/ui/index/
- Help center API collection: https://help.raklet.com/en/collections/13838830-api
